notes.text: The barley stood ripe. Riders had burned two villages to the south in spring, and the cellar under Yusuf’s house held one jar.
Meryem is assigned to household work. They have kept time for their own routine. Their last local stop was public garden.

Kian is assigned to supervised stores assistance. They have kept time for their own routine. Their last local stop was local workplace. They read public work notes from Tariq, Meryem; the writers’ perspectives are unrecorded.
Kian checked the guest stores with Tamar; no care duty was waived.
Tamar of the Wall checked the near approach in daylight without claiming future safety.
Hajja Maryam prepared a household portion; its grain remains real food in those jars.
Tariq prepared light materials under Yusuf Usta’s supervision.
Yusuf Usta compared the visible line with the workers; the ground remains uncertain.
Kian shared actual household grain and jar water with Ada, then rested with her. Her care record changed; their return remains unverified.
Meryem checked the household provisions without taking another house’s grain.

Kian ends his optional refuge work at a quiet boundary; Ada remains with him. Their exact return duty and changed care record remain. No completed journey or return is claimed; onward transfer is refused here.
